Fried Cinnamon Strips
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, March 8, 2010 - 12:03am

Ingredients




1 cup Sugar
1 teaspoon Cinnamon
1/4 teaspoon Nutmeg
10 Flour tortilla shells
Cooking oil

Preparation

1 In a large resealable plastic bag, combine sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg; set aside. Cut tortillas into 3-in. x 2-in. strips. Heat 1 in. of oil in a skillet or electric fry pan to 375 ; fry 4-6 strips at a time for 30 seconds on each side or until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. While still warm, place strips in bag with sugar mixture; shake gently to coat. Serve immediately or store in an airtight container. 2 Yield: 5 dozen.
